ALGER — Ooredoo Algérie publie un bilan: ALGIERS — Ooredoo Algeria publishes a solid financial report for the first half of 2026, with turnover up 14.5% and a customer base exceeding 15.9 million subscribers. The operator is increasing its investments by 74.1% to accelerate its digital transformation.
Croissance financière marquée au premier: Marked financial growth in the first half of 2026
Ooredoo Algérie a publié hier, mardi 28: Ooredoo Algeria published yesterday, Tuesday July 28, 2026, its financial results for the first half of 2026, confirming a sustained performance trajectory. Turnover increased by 14.5%, from 56 to 64.2 billion Algerian dinars compared to the same period in 2025. This dynamic is accompanied by an improvement in profitability, with EBITDA increasing by 12.1%, reaching 28 billion Algerian dinars (compared to 24.9 billion in 2025).
La gestion rigoureuse des coûts et l'opt: Rigorous cost management and optimization of operational performance made it possible to strengthen the profit margin. At the same time, the customer base recorded a growth of 9.7%, amounting to 15.9 million subscribers as of June 30, 2026, compared to 14.5 million a year earlier. This progression reflects the confidence of Algerian users in the services offered by the operator.
Investissements records pour accélérer l: Record investments to accelerate digital transformation
Ooredoo Algérie a consacré 14,9 milliard: Ooredoo Algeria dedicated 14.9 billion Algerian dinars to its investments in the first half of 2026, an increase of 74.1% compared to the 8.6 billion invested during the same period in 2025. These funds aim to modernize telecoms infrastructure, improve the quality of the network and support the country's digital ambitions.
Le Directeur général de Ooredoo, M. Roni: The Managing Director of Ooredoo, Mr. Roni Tohme, underlined the company's commitment: “The performances recorded illustrate the relevance of our strategic vision and the commitment of our teams. The growth of our financial indicators, the expansion of our customer base and the acceleration of our investments demonstrate our desire to offer an ever more efficient experience while contributing to the digital transformation of Algeria. »
